item: The last two unprefixed ThreadPoolExecutor pools in src/ carry a thread_name_prefix and the pin requires one on every pool
summary: src/llm/concurrency.py run_concurrent's pool is now oo-llmbatch and src/ingest/segmented_download.py segmented_fetch's pool is oo-segfetch (R324); tests/test_threads_are_named.py requires every ThreadPoolExecutor in src/ to pass thread_name_prefix (red first on exactly those two) and replaces the two-file list that #1578 pinned. open_stats.thread_family files their workers under oo-llmbatch and oo-segfetch instead of ThreadPoolExecutor; the llm batch workers run the caller's function (langdetect, the coordinator, perception extract, the throughput bench, POST /api/llm/bulk), so any store open one makes is now attributed to oo-llmbatch, which is the point; the segmented fetch workers fetch bytes but their call chain (default_fetch_segment, guarded_session, load_settings, kv_store._open) can open the store on a settings-cache miss, now attributed to oo-segfetch. tests/test_open_stats.py's existing scan of every oo- name still passes. The pin also rejects an empty or None prefix and a non-oo- one, and follows concurrent.futures aliases. The diagnostics GET table gives oo-llmbatch_* only to the three rows that reach the pool and no longer lists ThreadPoolExecutor-*, which no pool in src/ produces. Not measured: how many store opens the llm batch or segmented fetch workers make on a real run.
